# Ok to Be Offended

> A podcast from Sharkbar Studio about real-life conversations and uncomfortable topics. Host Sandy and co-host Micah talk about what offends people, and how folks with different opinions can still find common ground.

The show is honest and usually funny, because they say the quiet part out loud. New episodes are on Spotify. Guests and listener topics are welcome. Crest & Coast soap sponsors the show.

Call the show at 503-500-3121.
